The structure of composition Tl4Hg8I24 (reduced formula TlHg2I6) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 36 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Hg centers in octahedral coordination by six I neighbors, while Tl adopts an octahedral environment with six I neighbors, and the I centers show four geometric neighbors (one Hg and three Tl). Corner-sharing between Hg and Tl octahedra and edge-sharing among Hg octahedra are observed. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 36 sites.
